Current app scope

Supported formats and honest limits.

LensPin works with static camera photos in Apple Photos and timestamped GPX tracks. Format support depends on what Photos and ImageIO can read, while optional EXIF editing has narrower requirements.

Published and reviewed September 17, 2026

iOS 17+

Static photos · Apple Photos · GPX 1.1 tracks with timestamps

Format name alone is not a guarantee.

A particular asset can still be unavailable, missing metadata, stored only in iCloud, or unsupported for Photos content editing. LensPin reports the outcome per photo.

Which photos become candidates

LensPin filters before it suggests.

Must have camera identity

Both EXIF make and model must exist, and the photo must match the camera the user selected.

Must have a usable capture time

The capture time drives matching. A clock offset can be applied for comparison without changing the original metadata.

Must not already have a location

Photos with an Apple Photos location are excluded, then checked again immediately before writing.

Must be a static photo

Screenshots, unknown-camera images, and videos do not enter the current camera-photo matching flow.

GPX input

Timestamped track points, not just a line.

The current parser accepts GPX 1.1 track points with valid latitude, longitude, and time. Original track segments remain separate, and implausible high-speed jumps are split for safety.

Read GPX requirements and troubleshooting →

System behavior

iOS and iCloud considerations.

iOS 26 and later

LensPin can use the system's continued-processing task for a user-started scan while the app is backgrounded or the device is locked.

iOS 17–25

Background time is limited. LensPin keeps the screen awake during scanning; a long absence may pause the task until the app returns.

iCloud-only originals

LensPin allows network access when Photos needs to download an asset. Time depends on connection speed, file size, and library state.

Storage for EXIF edits

Optional content editing may require a local original, processing time, and temporary storage. Failure does not undo a successful Photos-library location.
